errors.text_span: оценките на свързаност при работа от разстояние
errors.evidence: The chart's title is 'В офиса съм по-мотивиран/а да работя' (I am more motivated to work in the office), not 'оценките на свързаност при работа от разстояние' (assessments of connectivity in remote work). The description misrepresents the topic of the survey.

The description of the horizontal axis is incomplete. It correctly identifies the age groups but omits the crucial sub-grouping by gender ('Жена' and 'Мъж') within each age group, which is a key structural element of the chart.
The vertical axis does not have a label titled 'Процент'. The tick mark labels include the '%' symbol, but there is no overall axis title.

errors.text_span: стойностите са подредени в намаляващ ред от ляво надясно
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and does not describe any aspect of the chart. The x-axis categories are ordered by age group, not by value. The y-axis values are ordered in increasing order vertically.
The highest bar, at 57%, corresponds to the 'Мъж' (Men) category in the 45+ age group, not the 'Жени' (Women) category.
The phrase 'significantly higher' is subjective and constitutes an interpretation, which is forbidden by the prompt.

errors.text_span: Всяка от стълбовете представлява отделен диапазон за двата пола (женски и мъжки)
errors.evidence: This is structurally incorrect. Each group of bars represents one gender within an age range. Each individual bar within that group represents one of the five possible answers, not a 'range for both genders'.

errors.text_span: Някои от стълбовете са визуално подчертани чрез цветовете си, като например стълбовете за жени показват оранжево, а тези за мъже - синьо.
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart's legend. The colors do not represent gender. They represent the five levels of agreement ('1 - Силно съгласен', '2 - По-скоро съгласен', etc.) for both men and women.
